clips.title: The story
paras: Agamand Mills is a sprawling farm and windmill complex nestled in the northern heights of Tirisfal Glades. Once the proud estate of the wealthy Agamand dynasty, it has fallen into ruin and stands as the largest Scourge stronghold in the region.

The wealthy Agamand family built their estate around a vast milling network across northern Tirisfal. When the Third War broke out and the Scourge swept across Lordaeron, the patriarch Gregor Agamand refused to flee, fortifying the compound and convincing his retainers and laborers to make their stand. Their provisions and stone walls might have held, but their youngest son, Devlin Agamand, betrayed his blood. Devlin slaughtered the estate watchmen and let the walking dead into the sleeping quarters. Crippled from within, the remaining defenders were wiped out, and the family joined the mindless ranks of the undead.
